QuestInfo.name: Rescue the Residents!
QuestInfo.0: The Lion King's minion, Ani, is kidnapping townspeople.\n\nDefeat Ani and rescue the town residents.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the minion of Lion King, Ani, and protect the peace in Maple World.
QuestInfo.2:
It wasn't as easy as you had expected.

Ani, the prison guard, leaves the castle at the  top of every hour from 10 am to 10 pm to patrol. It might be wise to plan an attack once a day.
